data.rationale: The proposal covers the true flow (search, open restaurant, set date and guests, Notify, time window, Confirm) with the right parameters, but it frames the goal as an availability check with Notify optional, adds an unneeded city-switch step, and doesn't make the party size and time window clearly required parameters.
